source:
use core.files as files
use core.process as process

fn escape_json(s: String) String -> {
    result := s
        .replace("\\", "\\\\")
        .replace("\"", "\\\"")
        .replace("\n", "\\n")
        .replace("\t", "\\t")
    return result
}

fn run() {
    path :: process.argv().get(1) ?? panic("missing path")
    text :: files.read(path) ?? panic("read failed")

    name := ""
    count := ""
    note := ""

    loop line in text.trim().lines() {
        pair :: line.split_once("\t") ?? next
        key :: pair.before
        value :: pair.after
        if key == "name" -> name = ~value
        if key == "count" -> count = ~value
        if key == "note" -> note = ~value
    }

    print("{{\"count\":{count},\"name\":\"{escape_json(name)}\",\"note\":\"{escape_json(note)}\"}}")
}
